renderer_issues.reason: No mechanical rendering defect observed: returned views report zero parse errors and preserve canonical line correspondence. Semantic substitutions remain hypotheses.

evidence.why: Canonical operations identify storage and mutation, not the proposed gameplay interpretation.
Getter and setter directly access b10_to_12 without establishing a lowest-stock policy.

renderer_issues.reason: Proposed names add gameplay claims not proven by accessor bodies, including event completion, auto-handicap, mode-specific records and difficulty. The proposed LowestStocks setters merely assign packed fields; they perform no minimum comparison.

renderer_issues.issue: No visible structural rendering failure; all three pages report zero parse errors. Semantic substitutions nevertheless exceed what these bodies establish.
Rendered names describe all three predicates as target-test completion, although canonical code checks three separate storage locations. Their gameplay equivalence is unverified.
ClearUnlockMessageFlag clears the same x1B4C bit tested by IsFeatureUnlocked and used to guard timestamp registration. The rendered terminology obscures that shared state.
ResetHandicaps should not be read as resetting every mode: the explicit loops skip index 6 of the local cast array.

renderer_issues: All three rendered pages report zero parse errors and preserve canonical line alignment; no mechanical rendering defect was observed.
Proposed score-display, random-stage-switch and sound-test names add gameplay meanings not established by these bit-manipulation bodies.
Proposed full-data reset names can overstate coverage: the fighter and name routines clear selected record fields rather than whole objects.
The rendered deflicker getter hides the canonical call to GetRumbleSettingOfPort(5); equivalence to the saved deflicker field requires separate accessor evidence.

renderer_issues.issue: The renderer reports zero parse errors but leaves multiple proposed pointer-returning function names unchanged with status `shadowed_binding`, including gmMainLib_8015CC4C and gmMainLib_8015D0C0. Proposed-name coverage is therefore partial; this is a rendering limitation, not evidence against those hypotheses.

The reading view labels gmMainLib_8015D4A8 as GetClassicClearFlag amid neighboring TargetTest-labeled hypotheses. The canonical prototypes cannot resolve this apparent family inconsistency; the rendered label is not accepted as established semantics.
